notes: Bright houses subscribe: mailbox 250, doorstep 100. Miss one, or break its window, and it cancels.
Drab house windows 100, paid at the end of the day. Bundles refill papers. Training course: targets 100, jumps 200. Extra life at 15,000.

victories: deliver to every subscriber in one day.
hit every target on a training course.
readme: Term Paperboy: left and right steer, up speeds up, down brakes, Space throws a paper to the left, P pauses. Monday to Sunday, then the training course each evening.
claude: - Term Paperboy (owner 2026-10-26, locker order): authentic 1985 Paperboy rules and scoring (src/paperboy, 20 rule checks), a boy on a blue bike delivering rolled term papers along one street of her school neighbourhood that changes by the day; same amendment list.
